purpose: Resolve the active OMS-016 question without inventing a narrower route: determine whether public evidence supports an observed Xuzhou routing gap after incumbent service and local hydraulic capability are considered.

decisive_result.reason: Hydraulic-hose failure and emergency restoration are real, but the specific Rooter opportunity requires an observed post-incumbent routing gap. After targeted public research, that gap remains hypothetical while strong incumbent service, local multi-brand repair and local hose/fluid-system capability are directly evidenced. Continuing to narrow toward mixed-brand/out-of-warranty/sub-4h edge cases would preserve the story rather than discover a connection.
not_claimed: This packet does not claim that every Xuzhou hose failure is solved instantly.
It does not claim that a 24/7 neutral mobile-hose network exists citywide.
It does not infer low friction from absence of complaints.
It closes the route because OBSERVED_MISSING_EDGE and independent orchestration value remain unproven after incumbent search.

demand_pressure_real: Hydraulic hose failures can create equipment downtime and require safe repair/replacement.
XCMG maintenance guidance treats hydraulic hose installation as safety-sensitive work after repair/replacement.

incumbent_service.fact: Official service page states a China/global service network, 4-hour rapid response, general faults repaired within 24 hours, emergency rescue, fault diagnosis and parts/service infrastructure.

incumbent_service.actor: 嘉鸣福莱柯思液压科技
incumbent_service.fact: Official company site states a Xuzhou branch, hose-assembly capability, field tubing/layout prototyping experience and one-stop hydraulic solutions.

incumbent_service.actor: 徐州聚隆工程机械有限公司
incumbent_service.fact: Current official site describes multi-brand engineering-machinery parts, technical staff, repair/after-sales service and active hydraulic-pump repair content with public service hotlines.
Xuzhou-based official site supplies hydraulic hoses, hose assemblies, fittings and fluid-connection products/solutions with a public service contact.

supply_localization.actor: 卡特彼勒流体系统（徐州）
supply_localization.fact: High-pressure hose production in Xuzhou entered mass production on 2026-09-15 and serves OEM and after-sales markets, further reducing the plausibility of a generic local hose-supply gap.

public_research_result: Targeted searches for Xuzhou on-site crimping/mobile hose/24-hour hose dispatch did not establish a mature neutral citywide dispatch network.
However, failure to find that exact product category is not evidence of an opportunity.

No named recent Xuzhou machine owner was found publicly documenting measurable downtime/cost specifically because one hose could not be restored through OEM, dealer, repair-shop or local hydraulic channels.
No public evidence established that buyers are actively seeking a separate neutral routing/settlement layer rather than directly calling known service/repair/hose providers.

rooter_fit_recheck.conclusion: The route is technically routable but commercial orchestration value is not evidenced.

kill_conditions_hit: Mature OEM/dealer service exists with explicit rapid-response commitments.
Local multi-brand repair/service providers already exist.
Local hose/fluid-system capability is dense and increasingly localized.
No observed post-incumbent missing edge was bound.
A separate demand pump for neutral emergency routing was not evidenced.

human_probe.reason: Under the user's hard rule, HIGH Mobilization plus an observed narrow missing edge is required before spending founder time. OMS-016 never reached that threshold. A human call would now be searching for the opportunity rather than confirming one decisive residual.

next_existing_route.reason_selected: It is an already-persisted surviving route with a bounded task unit, abundant replaceable supply and strong operator exit potential. It remains fail-closed because China payer truth and self-propelled demand are unproven.
next_existing_route.next_truth: Use public research only to determine whether Chinese AI-built-app owners already pay for independent human production-readiness judgment and whether a recurring non-founder demand pump exists. Kill if domestic automated/freelance/security routes already solve the unit or if acquisition is founder-led education.
